title: How a Man of God Handles Dirty Jokes at Work
caption:
Somebody tells the joke. The whole table laughs. And you have about half a second to decide who you are.

You don't have to preach. You don't have to storm out. Keep your laugh, keep your answer short if anyone asks, and change the subject. Be the same guy at lunch you are on Sunday. Eventually someone will ask why, and that conversation is worth more than any speech.

"Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths." Ephesians 4:29

Send this to the guy who works next to you.
